item.text: I’m taking the next refactor step by extracting the search contract into explicit value types. That keeps the algorithm reusable without making the CLI or tests carry raw string pairs and ad hoc formatting.

I’ve got a concrete boundary to improve now: the CLI is still defining its own input type, and the search API still returns a bare list with no context. I’m replacing that with shared `SearchRequest` and `SearchResult` records so the code has one contract end to end.
The contract extraction is in place. I’m compiling the full set of sources into `/tmp` and running the CLI plus tests against the new shared request/result model.

item.text:
Refactored the codebase around explicit request/result types so the search logic, CLI, and tests all share the same contract. [SearchRequest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchRequest.java:1) now owns validated input, [SearchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/SearchResult.java:1) owns immutable matches plus formatting, and [NaivePatternSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearch.java:1) now exposes both the legacy `search(String, String)` path and a richer `search(SearchRequest)` API.

The CLI in [NaivePatternSearchCli.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchCli.java:1) now parses directly into `SearchRequest` instead of maintaining its own nested type, and [NaivePatternSearchTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/048_naive_pattern_searching/NaivePatternSearchTest.java:1) now verifies request/result preservation and result immutability in addition to the earlier behavior checks.
